oneOf.description: An administrator writes a consistent backup into a new directory (local SQLite profile).

A worker pool claims the oldest eligible queued job whose process it names, within its
work classes, and receives a job-bound worker credential with the assignment.

An administrator mints a worker credential bound to one job, its brief scope and
its deadline. The token is returned once and held by the running host only.

A trusted connector publishes one source revision. A JSON string is stored as
text; any other value is serialized JSON. The adapter follows `source.kind`.

task_context.description: Task evidence supplied to semantic applicability checks, not a collection write.

decisions.description: candidate index / family / condition index -> WP08 decision ID.

members.description: Explicit shortlist obtained from scoped retrieval; linked exceptions are added by the host.

delivery_grace_seconds.description: When set, a host-recorded job completion before expiry can be delivered within this grace.

required_effects.description: Invocation IDs within the execution job. The Host supplies the operation prefix.

decisions.description: J11 for the cohort and J12 for the complete proposal and each clause.

procedure.description: Omit for conditional knowledge. Procedure content includes its execution/investigation contract.

resources.description:
Resource identities: memories, artifacts, jobs, sources, or source-version scope IDs.
A source identity is deleted across its retained revisions.

decisions.description: One selected judgement decision per candidate event.

recurrence_seconds.description: Fixed intervals only; missed windows expire without a backlog of executions.

candidates.description: Bounded retrieval shortlist for indirect dependencies; J16 decides relevance.

removed_sources.description: Explicit removed source snapshots; the Host verifies their unavailable state.

depends_on.description: Named evidence fields containing results from earlier packets.

messages.description: The projected transcript and tool schemas, never provider credentials.

Scope.description:
Absent dimensions are unrestricted. An assigned restriction cannot be removed
by leaving that dimension out of a request. Tenant is checked separately.

text.description: A concise, complete statement; large detail stays in referenced artifacts.
